subject: general
question: Ravi and Raghu are brothers. Raju is the father of Raghu. Shyam is the brother of Tushar. Shyam is also the mother's brother of Ravi. How is Shyam related to Raju?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) Ravi and Raghu are brothers.

2) Raju is the father of Raghu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2a262543e6841a02e58c44168cceca163d213344c0755dc1fd74128ddcf4d27.png] 

3) Shyam is also the mother's brother of Ravi.

4) Shyam is the brother of Tushar. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e1a8ff4818892ff3efd09c8d8d53743735bc1a1cd19fa785aea7834c78ee0f5.png] 

Here, Shyam's is Raju's brother-in-law or wife's brother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
